page.title: Scheduled Reports
page.description: Send institute activity to your team on a schedule, instead of waiting for someone to come and look.

enable.label: Enable scheduled reports
enable.description: When off, nothing is generated and nothing is charged.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: Report days and windows are worked out in this timezone.

skip.label: Skip when there is nothing to report
skip.description: Recommended. Otherwise a quiet week still sends an empty report.

schedule.noDataBadge: no data in the last 30 days
schedule.sectionsError: Could not load the available sections. Refresh to try again — this is not the same as having no data.
schedule.noSectionsAvailable: No section has data for this institute yet.

preview.exceedsCap: That is above the {{max}}-per-run limit and will not run. Narrow the scope.
preview.freeNoAi: Free — no AI analysis on this schedule.
preview.aMonthAiAnalysis: a month for the AI analysis. The report itself is free; recipients are free; scope is what multiplies.

ai.label: Add AI analysis
ai.description: Reads the figures below and writes what to do about them — what to fix, who to reach, what learners are asking for. The report itself is free; only this is charged, and only when an analysis is actually produced.

creditCap.prefix: Refuse a run costing more than

recipients.helperText: Only people with an account can receive these — reports can name learners, so there is no free-text email option. Teachers are automatically limited to their own batches.

history.title: Recent reports
history.empty: Nothing sent yet. Reports appear here once a schedule runs.

whoReceivedDialog.heading: Who received it
whoReceivedDialog.emptyState: Nobody received this run. If it was skipped, the reason is above.
